mechanism.server: backend/server.py _full_validation always passes SOURCE_STATUS_FILE; approval_fingerprint includes the registry digest (any edit -> 'stale' until refresh, then 'invalid' unless re-signed); grounded_gate_errors requires a valid registry whose sha256 equals the record's binding

signature: source_status_sha256 is inside the signed record bytes, so changing the binding breaks the Ed25519 signature, and changing the registry breaks the hash match

backward_compatibility.detail: records without source_status_sha256 still parse, but evaluate(source_status_file=...) rejects them ('re-approval required'). No real record exists, so nothing currently valid is lost. No weakened checks.

tests: registry edit invalidates a correctly signed record
server: registry edit -> stale -> invalid after refresh
gate blocks unbound or invalid registry
operator_note: A future approval record must include source_status_sha256 equal to the SHA-256 of legal-status/source-status.json at signing time; LEGAL-REVIEW-HANDOFF section 5 and docs/approval-trust-model.md do not yet mention this field (untracked docs, not edited).
